payload.text: Hand run on hv's machine, recorded as such: utilz menuz install builds Release, replaces ~/Applications/Menuz.app, registers the app as a login item through SMAppService on its first run and launches it; status reports installed, running and the login item enabled; the menu is back after a logout and login, which is hv's keypress, confirmed by hv when back (hv AFK, decision 20: the registration and status are the part measured by vc).
